snippet.title: TapMazing - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
TapMazing is the ultimate tap-to-jump adventure! Navigate amazing mazes, tracks, and gauntlets in a lab with Po-G the Radigoo. Coming to Steam and Google Play Store!

📅 Release Date (Steam): 28 November 2025
🎮Steam (Demo): https://store.steampowered.com/app/3874100/TapMazing/
🎮Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.doctorrulogames.tapmazing.android
🎮Wishlist now Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3874100/TapMazing
🌐 Learn More: tapmazing.com
